import sys

ONES = [0] * 17
ONES[1] = 1
for i in range(2, 17):
    ONES[i] = 10 * ONES[i - 1] + 1

def recurse(x, length):
    x = abs(x)
    if x % ONES[length] == 0:
        return (x // ONES[length]) * length
    lower_bound = x // ONES[length]
    upper_bound = lower_bound + 1

    candidate1 = lower_bound * length + recurse(x - lower_bound * ONES[length], length - 1)
    candidate2 = upper_bound * length + recurse(upper_bound * ONES[length] - x, length - 1)
    return min(candidate1, candidate2)

def main():
    input_str = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    input_number = int(input_str)
    answer = recurse(input_number, 16)
    print(answer)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
